verdict.rationale: Bruno keeps collections as plain-text Bru files in a folder on your own filesystem, works offline only, and needs no account or cloud sync. Your data is therefore always in your hands and versionable with Git, so leaving needs no export step. Postman import/export (with a preserve-scripts option) adds a path to another tool, and the community independently confirms collections are human-readable text files. Missing for 10: evidence of export to standard open specs such as OpenAPI (Bru is a Bruno-specific markup), and explicit documentation of a full-data export covering environments and settings.
